notes: The complete 194-entry native and 140-base browser harnesses were rerun after final Lilith sources were frozen; both passed and both browser windows are closed.

All16 montage views and four reused-pose captures have been directly inspected. The18 views not containing Lilith remain byte-identical to the first inspection; both changed C montages and both complete Lilith captures were directly inspected after the final replay.

Lilith native correction was reviewed cell-by-cell:16 retained calm poses,4 final rear views and12 new frontal poses. First incomplete native edits and the rejected bilateral outro cell remain archived as review history.

Only the two Lilith PNGs and asset records changed relative to the archived334-entry snapshot. The332 other entries and PNGs, all20 frozen PartA artifacts and historical W10 evidence remain identical.
No body pixels were painted or mirrored by the QA scripts. Native source correction was produced by image_gen; Sharp only segments/scales/pads/packs or concatenates diagnostic captures.
Fallbacks remain historical accepted pixels and add no dedicated PNG or pose count.
Google Fonts external tunnel request failed; local assets and JavaScript checks passed.

knownLimitations.description: P2 mirror flips the accepted source image rather than redrawing one-sided anatomical markings for the opposite facing. Naturally occluded far-arm regions are not certified.

runtimeScope.reason: These harnesses call the real renderer and sprite/catalog selectors directly; final support laser_line behavior belongs to separate gameplay QA.
